newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to restructure Gazprom gas monopoly.
newsitem.headline: Russia to restructure Gazprom gas monopoly.

text.p: Russian Economy Minister Yevgeny Yasin said on Wednesday that the government would restructure natural gas monopoly Gazprom's domestic operations.

"We have prepared a large document for the government; in it is a proposal for restructuring Gazprom," he told a news conference. "The main part is, that which is a natural monopoly should be gradually removed -- this concerns first and foremost the transport of gas."

"Our foreign clients of natural gas say, "Listen, Gazprom is first of all a major international corporation, and if you cut yourself up and conduct some experiments, then your position on the world market will also weaken," Yasin said. "Therefore, we will not do that.
"Domestic restructurisation -- yes. But we will not weaken Gazprom as an international corporation."

Yasin said Gazprom had agreed to restructuring and the government would take concrete measures on the matter soon.
"It's interesting, by the way, that these proposals are generally agreed to by Gazprom," he said.
Gazprom produces 94 percent of Russia's natural gas and is the world's largest natural gas company.
